name: Aegis Pest Detection Rover
title: Aegis *Rover*
summary: An autonomous rover that patrols a farm plot and uses computer vision to detect soil and crop pests. Each time a pest is identified, it sends an instant alert to the owner's phone via Telegram, enabling timely, targeted intervention and reducing crop losses.
lede: An autonomous rover that patrols a farm plot and uses computer vision to detect soil and crop pests. Each time a pest is identified, it sends an instant alert to the owner's phone via Telegram, enabling timely, targeted intervention and reducing crop losses.

details.label: Core Components
details.value: Wheels . Robotic Arm . GPS Module . IR Proximity Sensors . Raspberry Pi 5

overview.title: Crop protection that never sleeps
paragraphs: Aegis autonomously scans a farm plot, using a computer vision algorithm to identify soil and crop pests as it moves. Each detection sends a notification straight to the owner's phone on Telegram, so action can be taken before the damage spreads.
Pests are often spotted too late, after the harvest is already at risk. Aegis patrols the plot consistently, replacing occasional manual inspection with regular, reliable coverage.

features.title: Autonomous patrol
features.text: Covers the farm plot without manual control.

features.title: Soil pest detection
features.text: Identifies pests in and around the soil.

features.title: Crop pest detection
features.text: Spots pests on plants and foliage.

features.title: Computer vision
features.text: Recognises pests from live camera imagery.

features.title: Instant Telegram alerts
features.text: A notification to the owner's phone each time a pest is found.

features.title: Targeted intervention
features.text: Know when and where to act, and cut crop losses.

steps.title: Patrol
steps.text: The rover travels the plot on its own.

steps.title: Detect
steps.text: The vision algorithm analyses what the camera sees for signs of pests.

steps.title: Alert
steps.text: A confirmed detection triggers a Telegram message to the owner.

steps.title: Act
steps.text: The farmer responds early and treats only what needs it.
